contentHtml:
The Nafis Scholarship Program offers an incredible opportunity for Emirati students. Under this program, they receive 100% tuition coverage for their higher education. It’s a golden chance to study in the UAE’s leading educational institutions. The scholarships aim to break financial barriers. While providing students to pursue careers in critical sectors, including pharmacy and healthcare. The UAE pushes for Emiratization and expands its human resources. These scholarships pave the way for future leaders in the healthcare industry.

Many universities are offering scholarship programs to dedicated Emiratis. Among them are two major universities Dubai Pharmacy College and Gulf Medical University. Both are fully aligned with the UAE’s vision to foster skilled Emirati professionals. Ones who can contribute to the nation’s growth.

Let’s take a closer look at the:

  • Eligibility criteria
  • Application deadlines, and
  • The application process

For the Nafis Scholarships for the 2025 intake.

What is a Scholarship? Understanding Nafis Scholarship

A scholarship is a financial award. It helps students pay for their education. Similarly, the Nafis Scholarship specifically offers Emirati students full tuition coverage. As a result, they pursue healthcare-related degrees at top UAE institutions.

Key Highlights of the Nafis Scholarship Program

The Nafis Scholarship Program is designed to achieve the academic and professional dreams of Emirati students. With no worry of financial constraints, explore what makes this program stand out:

100% Tuition Coverage: The scholarship covers the entire tuition fee. This may include registration and other related academic fees.

Applicable to Various Fields: The scholarships are offered for programs in:

  • Pharmacy
  • Nursing
  • Physiotherapy, and
  • Other healthcare-related fields.

Open for Emirati Students: Available to Emirati nationals to support their educational aspirations.

These scholarships provide more than just financial assistance. Emiratis will be equipped with professional training, mentoring, and career counseling. The purpose lies in making students excel in their academic journey and future careers.

Eligibility Criteria for Nafis Scholarships in 2025

Universities have set clear eligibility guidelines to ensure that only qualified candidates receive the Nafis Scholarship. Take a look at the basic Nafis scholarship requirements you need to meet.

Requirement Details
Nationality Emirati nationals only
Education Completion of secondary school (High School)
IELTS Score (for Gulf Medical) Minimum score of 4.5 or equivalent
Program Available for several undergraduate healthcare programs
Field of Study Pharmacy, Nursing, Physiotherapy, Anesthesia, Medical Imaging, etc.
Application Form Must indicate interest in the Nafis Scholarship during admission

Academic Qualifications

Applicants must have completed their secondary education to apply for the Nafis Scholarship. Completion along with the necessary grades. Plus, some programs may require specific English proficiency scores. Gulf Medical University has a criteria to score 4.5 in IELTS. While Dubai Pharmacy College might have slightly different academic prerequisites. The main thing is to check each university’s specific requirements.

How to Apply for the Nafis Scholarship in 2025: Step-by-Step Guide

Follow a simple process to apply for the Nafis Scholarship. Take the correct steps so that your application is successfully submitted. A step-by-step procedure is shared below:

Step 1: Choose Your Program

Decide on the program you wish to pursue. The Nafis Scholarship is available for various healthcare-related degrees, including:

  • Pharmacy
  • Nursing
  • Physiotherapy, and more.

To apply, must meet the prerequisites for the program you wish to apply for.

Step 2: Indicate Interest in the UAE Scholarship

Select the Nafis Scholarship option during the university’s application process. Choose this option to indicate your interest. This step is essential for being considered for the scholarship.

Step 3: Complete the Application Form

Read and fill out the online application form provided by the university. Submit the necessary documents as required such as your:

  • High school transcripts
  • English proficiency score, and
  • Any other relevant documents.

All information should be accurate and complete.

Step 4: Submit Your Application

Submit your application before the deadline. Late applications may not be considered. It is wise to apply well in advance.

Step 5: Attend Interviews and Evaluation (if applicable)

Some universities may require an interview as selection process part. Don’t take this opportunity easy and showcase your passion for the field. It’s a fortune to bring out your motivation to succeed in your chosen career.

Important Dates: Application Deadlines for the 2025 Intake

Timing is crucial when applying for the Nafis Scholarship. Note that, each university has different deadlines for applications. Below is a quick look at the application timelines:

University Application Deadline for 2025 Intake Course Start Date
Dubai Pharmacy College June 2025 September 2025
Gulf Medical University August 2025 September 2025

Both universities encourage applicants to apply early. First come first serve policy as seats are limited. Just keep track of these deadlines and prepare your documents ahead of time. Resulting in a smooth application process.

Benefits of the Nafis Scholarship

The Nafis Scholarship is designed to empower Emirati students. Helping them succeed academically and professionally. Some of the key benefits you’ll receive with this scholarship:

—> Financial Freedom:

The 100% tuition coverage will let you free from the cost of education.

—> Career Support:

The scholarship offers access to coaching, mentoring, and professional training beyond financial aid. This will help you develop into a skilled healthcare professional.

—> Prestigious Institutions:

Dubai Pharmacy College and Gulf Medical University are renowned for their excellent faculty and state-of-the-art facilities. This way, every Emiratie receives only top-tier education.

—> Networking Opportunities:

Join a network of talented Emirati students and professionals as a Nafis scholar. One who is shaping the future of healthcare in the UAE.

Final Thoughts: Your Pathway to a Successful Career in Healthcare

The Nafis Scholarship offers an extraordinary opportunity for Emirati students. Giving them a chance to pursue their dreams in the top sectors. The good news? No need to face the burden of tuition fees. There are plenty of options but we’ve compiled a few. Opt to study Pharmacy at Dubai Pharmacy College or enroll in one of Gulf Medical University’s medical programs. Both universities are huge names to build your career path. Having this scholarship in your hand means receiving the financial and academic support needed to succeed.

FAQs

Q1: Can I apply for the Nafis Scholarship if I have not yet graduated from high school?

You are eligible if you are near to completing your secondary education. But, you must provide final high school grades. Right before the application deadline.

Q2: Are the scholarships available for postgraduate programs?

The Nafis Scholarship currently only covers undergraduate programs for Emirati students.

Q3: Will there be any other financial aid options available for me?

The Nafis Scholarship covers 100% of tuition fees. As an Emirati, you may also be eligible for extra funding or support services. This is specifically offered by the university.

Q4: What happens if I miss the application deadline?

Submit application early is advisable. Check the deadlines and apply early as applications submitted after the deadline will not be considered.
